verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component. "Running the product headlessly / in CI for automation" is an axis for software tools, so applying it to a processor is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip shipping a headless or CI automation mode of its own: vPro eligibility, oneAPI tooling and Linux compile benchmarks are adjacent or host-side and do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
